text_block_list.text:
Yes... Well, my skin's been a bit dry
recently, but
I'm otherwise doing fine.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's nothing to see a doctor
about!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Mother. I know you're
probably
busy. You don't need to come
to the academy...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: You can't be serious! You're going to run all the way here and call it training?!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
It's fine! I'm happy just knowing you
care! Of
course... Yes... Goodbye.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Mother's as full of energy as ever.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I forgot to ask her to send my
moisturizer!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
